entities.name: Lars Hætta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lars Hætta was a Norwegian Sami reindeer herder, prisoner, wood carver and Bible translator. Following the Sami revolt in Guovdageaidnu in 1852 he received a death sentence, which was commuted to life imprisonment.
